note: Minispiel „Das Blatt im Schnee“ auf dem Paradeplatz (Kapitel 2, Konrad; TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE 12.8, owner plaza-polish). Nüchterner Ton, nie strafend; der Fundtext steht in de_explore_plaza.json (explore.plaza.leaflet.*). Allgemeine Knöpfe: mg.common.* in de_minigames.json.

strings.mg.leaflet.title: The sheet in the snow
strings.mg.leaflet.subtitle: In front of the barrier a sheet drifts through the snow, a carbon copy with names and house numbers. The two sentries take turns watching the parade and the crowd.
strings.mg.leaflet.instruction: Walk to the sheet and stoop for it, but only while neither sentry is looking at you. Standing on the sheet, you hold it against the wind with your foot.
strings.mg.leaflet.status.walk: The sheet lies in the snow a few steps away.
strings.mg.leaflet.status.foot: Your foot is on the sheet. The wind can’t take it now.
strings.mg.leaflet.status.gust: A gust pushes the sheet across the snow.
strings.mg.leaflet.status.pinned: The gust tugs at the sheet, but your foot holds it.
strings.mg.leaflet.status.turn: A sentry turns his head away from the parade.
strings.mg.leaflet.status.sweep: A gaze sweeps across the crowd.
strings.mg.leaflet.status.bend: Konrad stoops as if to tie a shoelace.
strings.mg.leaflet.status.nothing: Only snow. The sheet is somewhere else.
strings.mg.leaflet.fail.noticed: The sentry looks over. Konrad straightens up and brushes the snow off his coat. Nothing else happens.
strings.mg.leaflet.solved: The sheet disappears into his coat pocket. Nobody saw.
strings.mg.leaflet.hint.1: Tip: When a sentry turns his head from the parade, his gaze is about to sweep the crowd. Only stoop once both are watching the parade again.
strings.mg.leaflet.hint.2: Tip: Stand on the sheet and your foot will hold it. Wait there until both gazes have passed, then hold S or the down arrow until you have it.
